name: Gu Yong Zhe (孤勇者)
blurb: Eason Chan's Chinese theme for Arcane, which became a schoolkids' anthem on Douyin in 2022
title: Gu Yong Zhe (孤勇者) by Eason Chan: Why It Went Viral on Douyin
description: 孤勇者 (Gu Yong Zhe) is Eason Chan's Chinese theme song for Arcane, released on 8 November 2021. In 2022 it became a playground anthem for Chinese kids via Douyin.
h1: Why did "Gu Yong Zhe" (孤勇者) go viral?
answer: 孤勇者 (Gū Yǒng Zhě, roughly "the lone brave one") is a song by Hong Kong singer Eason Chan (陈奕迅), with lyrics by Tang Tian (唐恬) and music by Qian Lei (钱雷), released on 8 November 2021 as the Chinese theme song of the animated series Arcane (英雄联盟：双城之战). It first caught on with gamers and anime fans, then in 2022 spread to primary-school children through Douyin and other short-video apps: clips of kids singing it together at school gates, and of adults humming the opening so passing children would finish it like a secret password, went everywhere. Chinese media started calling it a "new children's song".

body: The Douyin trend was about group singing, not a dance. Typical clips show a street musician or teacher playing it while a crowd of schoolchildren gathers and sings along; an adult casually humming the first notes and nearby kids instantly joining in, nicknamed 对暗号 (exchanging passwords); and whole classes belting it out at sports days or in class.

Many of these children were not Eason Chan fans and had never seen Arcane. Teachers said most first heard it in short videos on their parents' phones. The rousing melody and steady beat make it easy for a group to shout-sing.

head: Date
Event
rows: 孤勇者 is released as the Chinese theme song of Arcane
It spreads among gamers and anime fans, and fan edits set to it appear on Bilibili
Official media use it as background music for clips about the Winter Olympics, China's women's football team and medical workers
Videos of schoolkids singing it, and "password" clips, flood Douyin
CCTV reports on a Kunming class that lost a tug-of-war and sang it together through their tears
Eason Chan performs it at the CCTV Spring Festival Gala

body: 孤勇者 means something like "one who is brave alone": a person with no halo and nobody's backing who still chooses to face the fight. That echoes the characters of Arcane, and many listeners hear it as a song about themselves.
Lyricist Tang Tian is a longtime Eason Chan fan, and reports say writing for him fulfilled a wish she had held for years.

ul: Named in NetEase Cloud Music's and Tencent Music's top ten songs of 2021
Included in People's Daily's top ten BGMs of 2022
KKBOX Taiwan yearly Mandarin singles chart: No. 3 in 2022 and No. 2 in 2023
Covered from 2022 by singers including Tengger, Angela Zhang and Phoenix Legend

faq.a: Hong Kong singer Eason Chan (陈奕迅). The lyrics are by Tang Tian and the music by Qian Lei; it was released on 8 November 2021.

faq.q: What show is 孤勇者 from?
faq.a: It is the Chinese theme song of Arcane (英雄联盟：双城之战), the animated series based on the game League of Legends.

faq.q: Why do Chinese kids all know 孤勇者?
faq.a: In 2022 it spread through Douyin and other short-video apps, often heard on parents' phones. Its rousing tune suits group singing, and viral "password" clips turned it into a playground anthem.
